content:
maria: heads up: console showing a small streaming session with a -12 provisional token delta after a region handoff, customer opened a ticket.
kevin: can you paste the logs and screenshot?
maria: logs pasted: 
2026-03-14T07:21:14Z router: session=svc-77 route=us-west-2 -> eu-west-1 reason=capacity_failover
2026-03-14T07:21:14Z runtime: session=svc-77 prefix_len=19 tokens_emitted=30 status=streaming
2026-03-14T07:21:15Z runtime: session=svc-77 toolcall=ocr_v2 truncated=true tokens_tool=6
2026-03-14T07:21:17Z router: session=svc-77 ack=resume confirmed=true
2026-03-14T07:21:17Z billing: session=svc-77 provisional_delta=-12

maria: looks like provisional got credited on origin shard, then reconcile subtracts on final shard so origin shows negative.
sam: we have retry dedupe via session+seq but provenance is lost when router overwrites route_tag.
kevin: router currently replaces route_tag on handoff; ledger keys are route_tag+session_prefix, so a tag change writes two separate ledger entries.
irene: runtime sends request-trace-id but billing doesn't include it.
ben: consequence: negative line on origin, refund on final, console surfaces origin only so support confuses customers.
maria: customer-facing UX is bad. our auto-refund rule also triggered.
kevin: short-term: router should attach X-Orig-Route on handoff and ledger should use an idempotency key that includes orig_route to merge provisional writes.
sam: idempotency key proposal: session_id|client_prefix|orig_route. low friction to add.
irene: but analytics: we still need to attribute confirmed cost to the final route for dashboards; provenance only for dedupe.
kevin: implementation plan: router: add X-Orig-Route header (1d); runtime: include trace id in billing events (0.5d); ledger: add idempotency merge on provisional create (2d); reconcile: emit confirmed_cost with final_route tag + audit record (2d); console: label provisional rows "pending adjustment" and link reconcile trace (1d). ~6d total, staged.
ben: ops-bot: creating incident INC-2026-052 assigned eng-platform.
ops-bot: canary router change at 10% started  initial logs show X-Orig-Route preserved in ~95% of handoffs.
maria: temporary UI mitigation: hide or label negative provisional rows until reconcile completes; I'll PR.
kevin: will open router PR and test header preservation and add a sim to reproduce negative provisional.
sam: I'll add unit test for edgecase where toolcall truncated event is logged on origin and final ack happens on new shard. ensure idempotency keys unify both writes.
irene: add alert if net negative provisional > threshold across shards in 5m.
ben: summary: root cause = route_tag mutation during handoff + ledger keyed by route_tag. fix = provenance header + ledger idempotency + reconcile audit + console UX.
maria: filing support template and posting to #customer-support. cc @kevin.
kevin: tracking PRs: router r/4012, ledger r/4015, console r/4016, tests r/4017.
ben: incident INC-2026-052 marked monitoring; will close when canary 100% and negative provisional rate <1/min.
ops-bot: INC-2026-052 status: monitoring.
